title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (November, 2025)
summary: The November 2025 cumulative update roundup lists BC27.1 (2025 wave 2, CU01) with its SaaS and on-premises build numbers, plus BC26 CU07, BC25 CU13 and BC24 CU18 (end of life). It also gives lifecycle tables for on-premises versions under the modern and fixed policies, with support dates.
key_points: BC27.1 is generally available; new SaaS customers get it automatically, and existing customers are notified by email
Updates released: 27.1, 26.7, 25.13 and 24.18, with application and platform build numbers
BC27 on-premises support runs from October 1, 2025 to April 6, 2027 under the Modern Lifecycle Policy
Lifecycle tables cover versions 15 to 27 under the modern policy and versions 13 and 14 under the fixed policy
The post links to an earlier article on the BC25 change to more flexible environment updates
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in Admin Center

quotes.text: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center
quotes.why_it_matters: This new capability in BC27.1 allows better control over SaaS environments, improving operational flexibility

quotes.text: Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: BC25 now provides extended update windows, giving customers more time to plan and test updates before mandatory deployment
